claims.text: Many reviewers love the product, praising how soft and cleansed their skin feels after use.
Several reviewers report no noticeable difference in their skin and feel the product is overhyped.
Some reviewers find the product easy to apply and enjoy its fresh smell and pleasant texture.
A few reviewers report skin irritation or breakouts, with some saying it is not good for sensitive skin.
Some reviewers note the product does not rinse off well and can stain.
